generation: zero-NIM deterministic subject+predicate query from a semantic triple in the gold chunk

reused_assets.chunk_sidecars: Authoritative production-v2 FAISS index plus SQLite metadata used for targets, retrieval, and presence checks.
reused_assets.complex_smokes: Broad multi-leaf end-to-end traces; unsuitable for isolated direct-chunk scoring.
reused_assets.development_assertion_200: Reusable controlled query/gold structure and exclusion set; not reused as chunk cases because it is development data.
reused_assets.diagnostic_fixtures: Small or development-exposed fixtures retained for tests only.
reused_assets.global_natural_packet: 20 source-first questions, 14 adjudicated eligible; useful for later natural-query corroboration but too small/heterogeneous for the primary held-out set.
reused_assets.heldout_assertion_100: Reusable frozen schema and exclusion set; not rerun or modified.
reused_assets.stabilization_gates: Focused hand-picked regression checks; unsuitable as a representative held-out set.

sampling: one candidate per shuffled batch, then round-robin across document family, object type, and chunk-position strata
